text: eToro Group Ltd. is an Israeli-founded, UK-headquartered trading platform that went public on Nasdaq in May 2025, pricing an upsized IPO of 13.7m Class A shares at $52.00 for gross proceeds of $403m; founders retain control through a dual-class structure. There is no state stake. Human-rights relevance is retail-CFD selling conduct and crypto exposure.

source.name: eToro Group Ltd. Form 6-K (SEC) - IPO consummation
